name: product-workflows
description: Seventeen slash commands for defining a product — its requirements, architecture and specification: a six-command BRD-to-PRD route (/brd-intake → /brd-split → /prd-ground → /brd-split → /brd-interview → /brd-package → /brd-reconcile) that grounds a customer's requirements document, settles it with them and seeds the PRD, ARD and specification; the idea→PRD→ARD→specification ladder (/idea → /create-prd → /update-prd → /create-ard → /specify), /update-spec revising a merged specification, and /prd-ground optionally grounding the PRD; /epics, deriving Epics; /harvest-decisions and /promote-decisions, keeping merged ARD decisions as team records and promoting them to organisation ADRs; and /prd-proposal and /brd-proposal, pricing graded requirements in human hours, never money. Fourteen agents carry the grounding, review and Epic writing; twelve reference pages define the shared formats.
